_notes: Pre-registered settings (proposal, Table 5.6). Values marked TBD-on-dev are fixed on the development set; `python -m tierbot freeze` then records them before E1 runs on the evaluation set.

substrate._notes: paths: which paths every candidate is audited on (E0 needs both). reference: the path whose verdict is the verdict of record.

tiers._tbd: model pair: kept if the cheap tier repairs 20% to 80% of the dev bugs within its budget and the strong tier needs more than one round on at least a third of the rest; otherwise one step down (a local 7B model, then gpt-6-luna). n: the largest of 1, 3, 5, 10 at which at least half of the candidates of a call are distinct. reasoning_effort: none is kept if the cheap tier still repairs at least 20% of the dev bugs; otherwise low, without temperature.
tiers.name: cheap

tiers._tbd: budget (R2): kept if fewer than 5% of the repaired strong sessions need more than 10 rounds; otherwise 15. reasoning_effort is pinned at the model's default; no temperature is sent with reasoning on (the API may refuse it), and max_completion_tokens covers the reasoning tokens.
tiers.name: strong

step._tbd: stall rule of the cheap tier: a call has stalled when at most `stall_new_max` of its candidates made progress. 1 is kept if it loses at most 5% of the cheap tier's repairs on dev; otherwise 0.

budget_guard._tbd: r: the smallest r whose replay loses at most 5% of the plausible sessions; budget: the 90th percentile of the time to a plausible patch in the Strong-only sessions (TBD-on-dev).

e4._tbd: the handover chosen on the 50 bugs of E3: the fewest strong rounds per repaired bug with a repair rate within the margin of cold; otherwise cold.

prices._notes: Token prices are per tier. Money is reported twice: every input token at the list price, and with a prompt cache that holds, within one session, the prefix a tier already sent (prompts under cache_min_prompt_tokens are not cached).
